original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook that installs nginx on a target Ubuntu host, ensures the service is started and enabled at boot, and opens port 80 in the firewall.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook that installs nginx on a target Ubuntu host, ensures the service is started and enabled at boot, and opens port 80 in the firewall.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
- name: Install and configure Nginx with firewall on Ubuntu
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure APT cache is up to date
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        update_cache: yes
        cache_valid_time: 3600

    - name: Install nginx
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: nginx
        state: present

    - name: Ensure nginx service is enabled and running
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: nginx
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Ensure UFW is installed
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: ufw
        state: present

    - name: Allow SSH through UFW to prevent lockout
      community.general.ufw:
        rule: allow
        name: OpenSSH

    - name: Allow HTTP through UFW
      community.general.ufw:
        rule: allow
        port: "80"
        proto: tcp

    - name: Set default UFW incoming policy and enable firewall
      community.general.ufw:
        state: enabled
        direction: incoming
        policy: deny

    - name: Set default UFW outgoing policy to allow
      community.general.ufw:
        direction: outgoing
        policy: allow

- name: Install and configure Nginx with firewall on Ubuntu
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure APT cache is up to date
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        update_cache: yes
        cache_valid_time: 3600

    - name: Install nginx
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: nginx
        state: present

    - name: Ensure nginx service is enabled and running
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: nginx
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Ensure UFW is installed
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name: ufw
        state: present

    - name: Allow SSH through UFW to prevent lockout
      community.general.ufw:
        rule: allow
        name: OpenSSH

    - name: Allow HTTP through UFW
      community.general.ufw:
        rule: allow
        port: "80"
        proto: tcp

    - name: Set default UFW incoming policy and enable firewall
      community.general.ufw:
        state: enabled
        direction: incoming
        policy: deny

    - name: Set default UFW outgoing policy to allow
      community.general.ufw:
        direction: outgoing
        policy: allow
